name: delete_first_hole
why: Deleting is not suppressing: the feature disappears from the tree and there is no going back with another operation, only with `undo`. We delete the FIRST hole, which has no children, and measure all three things: the volume that grows, the hole that is missing WHERE it was missing, and one feature fewer in the list.
_why_the_centers: the volume says how much material came back, not which hole disappeared. With the one at x = -60 deleted the two at 0 and +60 remain: it is the difference between «it removed one» and «it removed the right one».

expect.tolerance_why: 400000 minus pi*7^2*20: the calculation has pi inside
400000 minus twice pi*7^2*20: the calculation has pi inside
the cylinder axis is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
the volume goes up by one hole: the calculation has pi inside
the cylinder axis is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
